scripts.test:firestore: node scripts/render-private-rules.mjs --test && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-quiet-ledger --only auth,firestore "pnpm test:integration"
scripts.test:public-e2e: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.public.test.json --project demo-quiet-ledger --only auth,firestore "node tests/public.e2e.mjs"
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-source-secrets.mjs && pnpm test && pnpm test:ui && pnpm build && pnpm build:public && node scripts/check-public-bundle.mjs && pnpm audit --prod
scripts.release:check: pnpm verify && pnpm test:firestore && pnpm test:public-e2e && node scripts/check-public-release.mjs
scripts.deploy:public: pnpm release:check && firebase deploy --config firebase.public.json --only hosting,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes
